name: time-tracker
description: Claude Code Time Tracker - idle-aware time tracking for Claude Code that runs 100% locally. Reads your ~/.claude logs and shows active hours (not wall-clock) per project/day/session, a work calendar, per-session token & tool usage, canon references, and optional AI prompt-health ratings. `setup` installs it, `launch` opens the dashboard in your browser, `stop` shuts it down, and `deploy-vercel` optionally stands up a private, magic-link-gated hosted version. Your transcripts never leave your machine.
